speaker: Frank Rieger and Ron
verbatim_text: Ich glaube, auf diesem Kongress ist klar geworden: GSM hat dann wohl kein Jahr mehr. Also nächstes Jahr auf dem Kongress wird wohl GSM ganz schön doll tot sein ... GSM als Basistechnologie ist jetzt mittlerweile in Hackerhand angekommen.

subject: GSM_practical_public_break
population: public practical attacks on core GSM security properties
outcome: public independent practical break of GSM security
indicator_frozen: Primary research presentations, released tools or datasets and independent technical replications demonstrate interception, decryption, impersonation or unauthorized network operation against deployed GSM.
threshold_success_frozen: At least one reproducible public attack against deployed GSM is presented or released by 2009-12-31 and independently confirmed or accompanied by usable artifacts.
threshold_contradiction_frozen: Authoritative technical reviews find that all announced 2009 attacks remain simulation-only or require undisclosed operator secrets; absence alone is non-fulfilment.
missing_conflict_rule: A laboratory flaw without practical deployed-network relevance does not qualify; lawful operation of a private BTS alone does not count as a security break.

outcome: documented post-delay recovery of protected user data

threshold_contradiction_frozen: Authoritative testing shows all then-current supported iOS devices remained inaccessible to every documented qualifying technique through the deadline; absence alone is non-fulfilment.
